quotes.text: Update line items in response to changes made during checkout.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: To use this feature, ensure your SDK version is `2025-03-31.basil` or later.
When updating line items, you must retransmit the entire array of line items.
`runServerUpdate` enforces a 20-second timeout for your update function.

findings: The November 14-line capture states a generic line-item-update purpose and links Full page and Embedded form variants (new raw lines 5-14). It contains no implementation body, permission matrix, API version, SDK code, line-item mutation rule or outcome. The April 21 capture is a detailed Checkout Session ui_mode: elements subscription example (old raw lines 4-63,93-149,170-287); its detail is neither renewed nor revoked by the index.

April old flow separates server authority and client refresh: server creates/retrieves Checkout Session and validates a constrained interval before sessions.update with full line_items array; client passes session ID, wraps a server call in runServerUpdate, handles non-ok/rejection and 20-second timeout, then changes local toggle only after success (old raw lines 47-149,170-287). Client-provided Session data is untrusted; Payment Intents API line items/amounts require separate manual tracking (old raw lines 19-21,65-75). A successful update is Session state refresh, not payment/subscription completion.

The source-stripe-checkout-dynamic-line-items.md summary says beta, works both payment and subscription modes, and requires SDK version 2025-03-31.basil+ (source lines 13-22). Old raw line 35 calls this an SDK version but code line 43 sets apiVersion; it shows a subscription example only (old raw lines 35-63), so the summary's both-mode claim is not established by the pinned old guide alone. Preserve the guide's literal wording while qualifying example versus demonstrated support and API-version field. November links cannot confirm these details (new raw lines 11-14).

The source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md primarily summarizes its separate April 20 shipping guide and explicitly dates its hosted/embedded dynamic-line-item unsupported statement to 2026-04-20 (source lines 14-22,62-69). The April 21 dynamic-line-items guide shows an Elements path, not hosted/embedded Checkout (old raw lines 47-63). The November Full page/Embedded form labels are navigation and create a current-scope question, not proof of support or a contradiction of the dated shipping-page claim (new raw lines 11-14).

Both sources need reciprocal provenance and scope warnings: the shipping source also lists the old line-items raw in frontmatter and links the dynamic source (source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md:6-9,62-79); the dynamic source links the Checkout concept (source-stripe-checkout-dynamic-line-items.md:87-95). Concept stripe-checkout.md line 142 repeats the dated UI support claim as unqualified current language, while line 141 already dates shipping callback deprecation.
historical_claims_to_preserve: April 20 shipping-page claim that dynamic line-item updates were unsupported in hosted and developing in embedded Checkout is dated in source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md:62-69; do not replace it with a November index-derived support claim.

April 21 Elements Checkout Sessions example: server API-version field 2025-03-31.basil, ui_mode elements, subscription price toggle, full-array id rules, trusted server Session retrieval, and 20-second runServerUpdate client timeout (old raw lines 19-21,33-149,170-287). These are not current Full page or Embedded form implementation instructions from new raw lines 9-14.

The shipping and dynamic-line-item features use related but distinct updates and UI scopes; old raw lines 14-17 describes combining shipping-rate changes with line-item changes, while the shipping source describes embedded-page onShippingDetailsChange and payment-mode-only flow (source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md:14-22,62-69).

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/dynamically-update-line-items, the entire November capture establishes only the purpose of updating line items during checkout and two linked variants, Full page and Embedded form (new raw lines 5-14). It provides no prerequisites, API/version or supported-mode rules. The April guide instead documents a Checkout Session ui_mode elements subscription example, with server-authorized update of the complete line_items array, client runServerUpdate and 20-second timeout, and Payment Intents API manual amount tracking (old raw lines 19-21,33-149,170-287). A Session update is not payment success. source-stripe-checkout-dynamic-line-items.md summarizes that dated path but overstates both-mode support and blurs API versus SDK version (source lines 13-22); source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md describes a separate April 20 embedded shipping callback and explicitly dated hosted/embedded line-item limitation (source lines 14-22,62-69). Both mapped sources need reciprocal November navigation and UI-scope qualification, with no inference that either new variant now supports the old Elements flow.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/dynamically-update-line-items, the visible delta is navigation/presentation: detailed April Elements Checkout Sessions content was replaced in this capture by Full page and Embedded form variant links (old raw lines 4-287; new raw lines 9-14). No substantive support, SDK, API or mode change is established until variant bodies are read. Preserve April's server-side full-array Session update, client runServerUpdate timeout, untrusted-client/session-ID boundary, subscription example and PaymentIntent manual amount responsibility as dated (old raw lines 19-21,35-149,170-287). source-stripe-checkout-dynamic-line-items.md needs a version/mode-scope warning and new raw route; source-stripe-checkout-custom-shipping-options.md must retain its April 20 shipping-only callback and dated unsupported-hosted/embedded claim while acknowledging the new index without declaring reversal (source lines 62-79). Checkout concept line 142 needs the same reciprocal dated UI qualification. A successful server update changes Session line items; it does not authorize or complete payment.
